children: Distribution Solutions Group will begin investor informational meetings on Sept. 10, 2026 and has posted an Investor Education Presentation that outlines a proposed merger and strategic plan.
Company to host investor meetings starting Sept. 10, 2026 and has furnished Investor Education Presentation as Exhibit 99.1.
Presentation discloses proposed merger with Eclipse Acquisitions Merger Sub, making DSG a subsidiary of Eclipse Parent via LKCM affiliate.
Proxy Statement and Schedule 13E-3 filings underway; shareholders urged to read proxy materials when available.
Presentation details take-private rationale by LKCM Headwater, financials (TTM Q2'26 revenue $2.05B, Pro Forma Adj. EBITDA $195M) and acquisition pipeline.
DSG posted financial metrics and non-GAAP reconciliations, and says presentation is furnished (not filed) under Reg FD.
